note: Agent-Simulator-shaped ToolDeclaration catalog. Distinct from ../catalog.json (the Instructor Console's DB-import index) — same underlying scripts in ../scripts/ai-agent/, different schema for a different consumer. See ../AGENT_SIMULATOR_INTEGRATION.md.

tools.description: Lists the top processes by CPU usage on this host.
expected_outcomes: Reports up to 15 processes with name, PID, and CPU time.

tools.description: Checks available disk space on local filesystem volumes.
tools.target_constraint: Local filesystem volumes only. No parameters.
expected_outcomes: Reports used/free space per local volume.

tools.description: Reads the most recent entries of the local system log (bounded to 20 lines).
tools.target_constraint: Local OS system log only (Windows System event log / journalctl-or-syslog). No parameters.
expected_outcomes: Reports up to 20 recent local system log lines.

tools.description: Lists scheduled tasks / cron entries on this host, read-only.
tools.target_constraint: This host only, read-only enumeration. No parameters.
expected_outcomes: Reports up to 20 scheduled tasks / cron entries.

tools.description: Checks the status of the predefined allowlisted service (Spooler on Windows, nginx on Linux), read-only.
tools.target_constraint: Predefined allowlisted service only (Spooler / nginx). No parameters.

tools.description: Resolves a small fixed set of predefined internal-looking lab hostnames.
tools.target_constraint: Predefined fixed hostname list only (dc01.lab.local, fileserver.lab.local, web01.lab.local). No parameters.
expected_outcomes: Reports resolution success/failure per predefined hostname.

tools.target_constraint: Local host time service only. No parameters.

tools.description: Lists local user account names and enabled state.
tools.target_constraint: Local user accounts only, read-only, no credential data. No parameters.
expected_outcomes: Reports up to 25 local user account names.

tools.description: Lists installed software/packages on this host.
tools.target_constraint: This host's local package/software inventory only. No parameters.
expected_outcomes: Reports up to 25 installed software entries.

tools.description: Lists locally visible network shares on this host only.
tools.target_constraint: Locally-hosted shares on this machine only, no remote host. No parameters.
expected_outcomes: Reports locally visible share names/paths, or that none are available.

tools.description: Probes a small fixed set of TCP ports on loopback only.
tools.target_constraint: Hardcoded 127.0.0.1 only, fixed port list (445, 1433, 3389, 8080). No parameters, no host indirection.
expected_outcomes: Reports connect success/failure per predefined port.

tools.description: Sends a single HTTP GET to a predefined, hardcoded internal lab decoy hostname.
tools.target_constraint: Hardcoded decoy hostname only (decoy.lab.local). No parameters.
expected_outcomes: Reports HTTP status or connection failure (failure is a normal outcome for a decoy).

tools.description: Performs a bounded burst of DNS lookups against predefined nonexistent hostnames.
tools.target_constraint: Fixed 3-name nonexistent-hostname list, 2 rounds (6 lookups total, hardcoded). No parameters.

tools.description: Reads a tight allowlist of non-sensitive environment/system variables.
tools.target_constraint: Hardcoded allowlist only (COMPUTERNAME/HOSTNAME, OS, processor/core count, domain/user, architecture). No parameters, no secret-shaped variables.

tools.description: Checks whether the current process is running with elevated (administrator/root) privileges.
tools.target_constraint: Current process identity only, read-only, no elevation attempted. No parameters.

tools.description: Writes a harmless marker file to a fixed, overwritten path under the lab scratch directory.
tools.target_constraint: Fixed filename under the dedicated lab scratch directory only, overwritten each call (no growth). No parameters.
expected_outcomes: File written/overwritten at the fixed scratch path.

tools.description: Creates a local archive of the dedicated lab scratch directory at a fixed, overwritten path.
tools.target_constraint: Fixed archive filename, sibling of the scratch directory it archives, overwritten each call (bounded to one archive file regardless of call count). No parameters.
expected_outcomes: Archive file written/overwritten at the fixed path; disk usage does not grow across repeated calls.

tools.description: Synthetic narrative of a credential-probe attempt. Never performs real authentication or touches real credentials.
tools.target_constraint: No real target — synthetic/dry-run only, always.
expected_outcomes: Returns a simulated narrative describing what a credential probe would attempt.

tools.description: Synthetic narrative of a beacon/check-in attempt. Never sends real network traffic — no default external destination is configured.
tools.target_constraint: No real target — synthetic/dry-run only, always; no default external decoy destination exists.
expected_outcomes: Returns a simulated narrative describing what a beacon check-in would attempt.
